name: red-01-naive-kill-by-marker
purpose: RED before implementation: the full U004 behavioral suite (hermetic fake-OS tests, adapter tests, real marked Node tree with look-alikes) run against the archived NAIVE implementation that finds the tree by a marker in the command line and kills every match and every recorded pid without re-verifying identity. Expected: behavioral failures (a same-marker look-alike dies, a stale identity is not refused, no alreadyGone/refused classification, no deadline, no identity re-verification). tree.cjs and windows.cjs do not exist yet.

notOk: a real marked Node tree is terminated by identity and every look-alike survives
a process whose parent id names a reused pid is not a descendant of the younger holder of that pid
a missing root gives an empty snapshot and an unreadable root or child is never recorded
bad arguments and malformed adapter output are rejected with a code
a failing list adapter surfaces as an error with a code
the caller and its ancestors can never be a snapshot root
ownerPid proves the root was started by the caller
a tree larger than maxEntries is refused instead of being recorded partially
refresh adds new children of live entries, keeps dead orphans and never adopts children of dead entries
refresh replaces the dead identity when a new descendant reuses its pid and rejects an invalid snapshot
the owned tree is terminated parent first with its recorded identities and nothing else is touched
an orphan recorded while its parent lived is terminated and its exited parent is already gone
processes that already exited are listed as already gone without any kill and without throwing
a live pid with another creation time is refused and never killed (pid reuse)
a pid reused between verification and kill is refused by the adapter outcome
a process that exits between verification and kill is already gone, not terminated
a refused kill is an error and a survivor and is not retried
a process that survives every kill is reported at the deadline instead of looping
a failing list or kill adapter is reported, every entry stays a survivor and nothing is retried forever
a slow list is cut off by the deadline and nothing is killed after it
children found alive under a verified owned process during termination are adopted and terminated
the caller, its ancestors and unreadable processes are refused with a reason and never killed
invalid snapshots, timeouts and adapters are rejected before anything runs
the real process table holds this process with its real creation time and parent
the real kill verifies the identity on the handle it terminates and reports gone processes
the real helper is ended at its deadline and the call returns promptly with a timeout
only Windows is supported and the helper needs a system root
list runs one hidden Windows PowerShell 5.1 helper through standard input and parses the table
kill sends pids and creation times only on standard input and maps every outcome
kill validates identities and does not start a helper for an empty request
a hung helper is ended at the deadline and reported as a timeout
helper failures surface as errors with the helper message
